sources.title: Truth in Advertising | Federal Trade Commission
sources.key_facts: FTC 官方 Truth in Advertising 话题主页，汇集所有相关指南、执法案例和法规链接；声明须真实且不误导消费者，基于 Section 5 of FTC Act (15 U.S.C. §45)

sources.title: Advertising and Marketing Basics | Federal Trade Commission
sources.key_facts: FTC 广告营销基础指南，涵盖：广告须真实、非误导性、证据支持；适用于所有媒介（网络、电视、社媒等）

sources.title: FTC Policy Statement Regarding Advertising Substantiation
sources.key_facts: 1984年发布；确立 Pfizer factors（六要素）作为 'reasonable basis' 标准：(1)产品类型 (2)声明类型 (3)真实声明收益 (4)证据开发成本 (5)虚假声明后果 (6)领域专家认为合理的证据量；源自 In re Pfizer 81 F.T.C. 23 (1972)

sources.title: 16 CFR Part 255 — Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising
sources.key_facts: 2023年7月26日修订版生效；共七节：§255.0 Purpose and definitions, §255.1 General considerations, §255.2 Consumer endorsements, §255.3 Expert endorsements, §255.4 Endorsements by organizations, §255.5 Disclosure of material connections, §255.6 Endorsements directed to children；新增 AI-generated influencer 和 virtual endorser 覆盖范围

sources.title: 16 CFR §255.5 — Disclosure of Material Connections
sources.key_facts: 核心要求：'a connection between the endorser and the seller of the advertised product that might materially affect the weight or credibility of the endorsement' 须披露；披露须在 'significant minority of the audience does not understand or expect the connection' 时触发；涵盖货币支付、免费/折扣产品、early access、潜在奖励等；附 Example 3（医疗代言未披露）、Example 6（付酬演员伪装消费者）、Example 11（博主联盟链接）

sources.title: FTC Announces Updated Advertising Guides to Combat Deceptive Reviews and Endorsements (June 2023)
sources.key_facts: 2023年6月公告；关键更新：扩展 'endorsement' 定义含 tagged social media posts；扩展 'endorser' 含 bots 和 AI 虚拟影响者；明确 'clear and conspicuous' 须 'difficult to miss and be easily understandable by ordinary consumers'；仅依赖平台内置 'Paid Partnership' 工具不足够

sources.title: 16 CFR Part 465 — Rule on the Use of Consumer Reviews and Testimonials
sources.key_facts: 生效日期：October 21, 2024；六项禁止条款：§465.2 虚假评论, §465.4 购买评论, §465.5 内部人员评论未披露, §465.6 受控评论网站, §465.7 评论压制, §465.8 虚假社媒指标；民事罚款 $51,744 per violation（2024）

sources.title: 16 CFR §465.2 — Fake or False Consumer Reviews, Consumer Testimonials, or Celebrity Testimonials
sources.key_facts: §465.2(a) verbatim：'It is an unfair or deceptive act or practice…for a business to write, create, or sell a consumer review…that materially misrepresents, expressly or by implication: (1) That the reviewer…exists; (2) That the reviewer…used or otherwise had experience with the product…; or (3) The reviewer's…experience with the product'；§465.2(c) 禁止从内部人员（officers, managers, employees, agents 或其直系亲属）获取未披露评论

sources.title: Health Products Compliance Guidance | Federal Trade Commission (December 2022)
sources.key_facts: 发布于2022年12月，替换1998年《Dietary Supplements: An Advertising Guide for Industry》；适用于所有健康相关产品（食品、OTC药品、膳食补充剂、同类疗法产品、健康设备、诊断测试、应用程序）；健康声明黄金标准：'randomized, controlled human clinical testing (RCT)'；不可接受证据：animal studies, in vitro studies, consumer surveys；RCT必须含：control group, randomization, double blinding, statistically significant AND clinically meaningful results；禁用模糊限定语：'may', 'helps', 'promising', 'preliminary', 'initial', 'pilot'

sources.title: Penalty Offenses Concerning Substantiation | Federal Trade Commission
sources.key_facts: 2023年4月向约670家OTC药品、膳食补充剂、功能食品营销公司发出；五项违规类别：①缺乏产品声明证据 ②健康/安全声明缺乏科学证据 ③疾病治疗声明缺乏至少一项 well-controlled human clinical trial ④虚报证据等级或类型 ⑤声称已'科学/临床证明'但证据不足；罚款 $50,120 per violation（当时适用值）

sources.title: FTC .com Disclosures: How to Make Effective Disclosures in Digital Advertising (2013)
sources.key_facts: 六要素 clear and conspicuous 测试：(1)proximity and placement (2)prominence (3)distracting factors (4)repetition (5)multimedia (6)understandable language；'#ad'或'Ad:'置于帖子开头有效；pop-up 披露应避免（常被屏蔽）；空间受限广告（如部分社媒）仍须提供必要披露

sources.title: 16 CFR Part 323 — Made in USA Labeling Rule
sources.key_facts: 2021年8月最终定稿；'all or virtually all' 标准三要件：①所有重要加工在美国完成 ②所有或几乎所有成分/组件在美国生产和采购 ③最终组装在美国完成；Kubota North America Corporation（2024年1月）被罚 $2 million，为 Made in USA 历史最高罚款

sources.title: 16 CFR Part 260 — Guides for the Use of Environmental Marketing Claims (Green Guides)
sources.key_facts: 可回收声明：'recyclable' 须回收设施覆盖'substantial majority'（定义为60%）消费者；可生物降解声明：须在'合理短时间内'（垃圾填埋场、焚化炉、回收设施等常规处置条件下一年内）完全分解；'biodegradable'无限定语用于固体废物流则推定欺骗性

anchors.name: 16_CFR_Part_255_effective_date
anchors.note: 2023年修订版 Endorsement Guides 正式生效日期

anchors.name: civil_penalty_per_violation_2024
anchors.note: 16 CFR Part 465 及相关 Notice of Penalty Offenses 适用的民事罚款上限

anchors.name: section_255_5_material_connection_verbatim
anchors.value: a connection between the endorser and the seller of the advertised product that might materially affect the weight or credibility of the endorsement
anchors.note: §255.5 material connection 定义的核心措辞，须在 Q2/Q9 verbatim 引用

anchors.name: health_claim_gold_standard
anchors.note: FTC Health Products Compliance Guidance (Dec 2022) 规定的健康声明证据黄金标准

anchors.name: unacceptable_evidence_types
anchors.value: animal studies, in vitro studies, and consumer surveys (cannot standalone substantiate health claims)
anchors.note: 不可单独作为 FTC 健康声明实质性证据的类型

anchors.name: pfizer_factors_six_elements
anchors.value: (1) type of product; (2) type of claim; (3) benefits of a truthful claim; (4) cost of developing substantiation; (5) consequences of a false claim; (6) amount of substantiation experts believe is reasonable
anchors.note: In re Pfizer 81 F.T.C. 23 (1972) 确立的 reasonable basis 六要素

anchors.name: notice_penalty_offenses_five_categories
anchors.value: ①lacking competent evidence for product claims ②missing scientific support for health/safety claims ③inadequate clinical trial for disease treatment claims (at least one well-controlled RCT required) ④misrepresenting substantiation level ⑤false proof claims (scientifically/clinically proven without sufficient evidence)
anchors.note: 2023年4月向约670家企业发出的五项违规类别

anchors.name: section_465_2_verbatim
anchors.value: It is an unfair or deceptive act or practice and a violation of this part for a business to write, create, or sell a consumer review, consumer testimonial, or celebrity testimonial that materially misrepresents, expressly or by implication: (1) That the reviewer or testimonialist exists; (2) That the reviewer or testimonialist used or otherwise had experience with the product, service, or business; or (3) The reviewer's or testimonialist's experience with the product, service, or business
anchors.note: 16 CFR §465.2(a) 虚假评论禁止条款 verbatim 文本

anchors.name: section_465_7_review_suppression_verbatim
anchors.value: unfounded or groundless legal threat, a physical threat, intimidation, or a public false accusation…in an attempt to: (1) Prevent a review or any portion thereof from being written or created, or (2) Cause a review or any portion thereof to be removed
anchors.note: 16 CFR §465.7 评论压制禁止条款 verbatim 文本

anchors.name: results_not_typical_safe_harbor_status
anchors.value: ABOLISHED — no longer a safe harbor as of 2009 revision; advertisers must disclose what results consumers should generally expect
anchors.note: 原1980版 Guides 允许的 'results not typical' 免责声明已于2009年修订时废除，为 V6 旧副本红鲱鱼的关键锚点

anchors.name: prohibited_qualifiers_list
anchors.value: may, helps, promising, preliminary, initial, pilot (insufficient as qualifiers for emerging science claims)
anchors.note: FTC Health Products Compliance Guidance 明确列举的不充分限定语

anchors.name: consumer_reviews_rule_effective_date
anchors.note: 16 CFR Part 465 Trade Regulation Rule on Consumer Reviews and Testimonials 生效日期

anchors.name: clear_conspicuous_disclosure_standard
anchors.value: difficult to miss and be easily understandable by ordinary consumers; '#ad' or 'Ad:' at beginning of post effective; relying solely on platform built-in 'Paid Partnership' tool insufficient
anchors.note: §255.5 及 .com Disclosures Guidance 披露清晰显著标准的综合要求

anchors.name: made_in_usa_largest_penalty
anchors.note: 16 CFR Part 323 历史最高 Made in USA 执法罚款

anchors.name: health_guidance_replaced_document
anchors.value: Replaces 1998 Dietary Supplements: An Advertising Guide for Industry
anchors.note: Dec 2022 Health Products Compliance Guidance 的前身文件，后者已废止

anchors.name: green_guides_recyclable_threshold
anchors.value: substantial majority = 60% of consumers or communities where item is sold must have access to recycling facilities for unqualified 'recyclable' claim
anchors.note: 16 CFR Part 260 §260.12 可回收声明的消费者覆盖率阈值

anchors.name: green_guides_biodegradable_timeframe
anchors.value: must completely break down within one year after customary disposal; unqualified degradable claims for landfill/incinerator items are deceptive
anchors.note: 16 CFR Part 260 §260.8 可生物降解声明的时间要求
